sources.quote: Some voice acting, music, graphics (SVG), store capsules and main menu art were created with AI generation tools, then reviewed and curated by the developer. The game's text is also translated into multiple languages with the help of AI: each of its more than 15,000 strings is translated with its in-game context and then checked by a separate, independent AI review. Feedback from native speakers is welcome.
